spans.s: ṛjī-kṛta-vant, adj. (perf. act. pple.), having made straight: LV 〔10.11〕 (prose) adhimuktim ṛjīkṛtavataḥ (gen. sg.). Regular Skt. would be ṛjū˚; the only v.l. cited is ms. A ṛjvī˚; even Calc. ṛjī˚; Tib. also draṅ por byas pa, having made straight. Presumably ī is due to analog. influence of stem-form in ī from stems in a, ā, i, ī before kṛ-.
